response.overview: The first novella, "Escape," tells the story of a hero who fled his feelings for another city and remembers the girl he left behind. The second novella, "Lost in Translation," is about a girl from a tribe living by the ocean. Every time she finds love, she loses her identity. The third novella is about a couple who, behind the mask of physical intimacy, have lost emotional intimacy. Their novella is called "Body Language."
response.title: The language of love
